feeds.title: Why Hunger Blog
feeds.description: WhyHunger's Blog features stories, projects and articles from community-based organizations, organizers and social movements. WhyHunger brings its unique assets and history to building a broad-based social movement to end hunger.

feeds.title: Action Against Hunger
feeds.description: Action Against Hunger is an international charity committed to saving the lives of malnourished children and supporting their families to beat hunger. For more than 40 years, we've led the global movement that aims to end life-threatening hunger for good within our lifetimes.

feeds.title: Greater Chicago Food Depository Blog
feeds.description: Our blog aims to inform, uplift and inspire our allies in the mission to end hunger. Follow along with new and noteworthy developments as we work to end hunger. Find the latest news updates and press releases from the Food Depository here. The Greater Chicago Food Depository is Chicago's food bank. We provide food and hope for Chicago and Cook County. Find food and get involved.

feeds.title: Welt Hunger Hilfe
feeds.description: Read Welthungerhilfe's latest articles around development cooperation and the fight against hunger. Welthungerhilfe is one of the largest private aid agencies in Germany; politically and religiously independent.

feeds.title: World Hunger Education Service
feeds.description: Read the latest news, announcement, articles on world hunger, nutrition, agriculture and more on World Hunger Education Service.World Hunger Education Service has helped fight hunger through knowledge as a resource of information & policy guidance. We will end world hunger.

feeds.title: Lakeview Pantry Blog
feeds.description: Our blog will educate, inform and encourage our friends, supporters and partners about hunger and poverty in Chicago and our mission to end it. At Lakeview Pantry is one of Chicago's largest and longest-operating food pantries.

feeds.title: Hawaii Foodbank Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest news and announcements from the Hawaii Foodbank Blog. Hawaii Foodbank provides food so that no one in our family goes hungry. We work to gather food and support from our communities. We then distribute food through charitable agencies to those in need.

feeds.title: Mid-South Food Bank » Hunger Blog
feeds.description: Mid-South Food Bank dedicated the following section to articles on Hunger, shedding light on those in need and providing a helping hand. Mid-South Food Bank provides food to local agencies and food distribution in 31 counties.

feeds.title: Congressional Hunger Center Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news, updates, events, policy and more on Congressional Hunger Center Blog.Congressional Hunger Center is a global nonprofit organization dedicated to the principle that access to nutritious, affordable, and culturally appropriate food is a basic human right.

feeds.title: Swipe Out Hunger Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news and updates from the Swipe Out Hunger Blog.Swipe Out Hunger is the leading nonprofit addressing hunger among college students. We promote on-campus solutions, policy and advocacy pathways, and student empowerment practices to address student hunger.

feeds.title: Hunger Task Force
feeds.description: Hunger Task Force believes that every person has a right to adequate food obtained with dignity. We work to prevent hunger and malnutrition by providing food to people in need today and by promoting social policies to achieve a hunger-free community tomorrow.

feeds.title: Hunger Free Oklahoma Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog for a variety of resources and information about ending food insecurity in Oklahoma. Hunger Free Oklahoma works to bring a unified, statewide voice to the issues and solutions surrounding hunger, with a goal to ensure all Oklahomans have access to affordable, nutritious food.

feeds.title: World Vision » Hunger
feeds.description: Find the latest news articles, stories and archives from World Vision about world hunger and providing food for those in need. World Vision partner with children, families and their communities to reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice.

feeds.title: The Hunger Project Blog
feeds.description: Get updates from The Hunger Project Global, our program countries, and stories from around the world of people ending their own hunger! We end hunger and poverty by pioneering sustainable, grassroots, women-centred strategies and advocating for their widespread adoption in countries throughout the world.

feeds.title: Rise Against Hunger India
feeds.description: Read the latest stories of impact, and the people who make it possible, from around the globe. Rise Against Hunger is growing a global movement to end hunger by empowering communities, nourishing lives and responding to emergencies.

feeds.title: Bread for the World
feeds.description: Bread for the World is a collective Christian voice urging our nation's decision-makers to end hunger at home and abroad. By changing policies, programs, and conditions that allow hunger and poverty to persist, we provide help and opportunity at home and far beyond where we live.
